How Website as a Service works

We build it. We launch it.

Then we keep taking care of it.

Axiom designs and builds a custom website for your business, puts it live, and then stays on as the team responsible for it. Here's exactly what happens, from our first conversation to every month after launch.

Start my website See the four stages

$297

/month

Design, build, hosting, updates and support, plus essential automations. One monthly price. Growth ($597/month) adds Google Ads management.

The process

Four stages. The last one keeps going.

Most website projects end at launch. With Axiom, launch is where the ongoing part of the relationship begins. Here's what happens at each stage, and what we'll need from you.

01

Stage 01 · Getting started

Tell us about your business

It starts with a conversation, not a pile of forms. We'll ask what you do, who your customers are, where you work and what you want people to do when they find you: call, request a quote, book or stop by.

What we do

Listen first and ask the right questions

Look at your current website, if you have one

Walk you through your site's scope and our terms before any work begins

What we need from you

Your business name, services and service area

Your logo and photos of your work, if you have them

How you want customers to reach you

A little of your time to answer questions

No logo or good photos yet? That's common. We'll talk it through together.

02

Stage 02 · Design and build

We design and build your website

We design a custom site around your business: your services, your photos, your service area and the way you talk to customers. Not a template with your name swapped in.

What we take care of

A custom design that fits your brand

Pages that look and work great on phones

Tap-to-call buttons and contact forms

Your services and service area laid out clearly

Local-search fundamentals built in

Your part: answer questions as they come up. Nothing technical.

bragspressurewashing.com

A recent Axiom build: custom design, clear services, quote and call buttons up front.

03

Stage 03 · Refine and launch

We refine it with you, then launch

You review a working version of your website on your own phone and computer, not a sketch. Tell us what you'd like changed in plain words and we'll refine it together. When you're happy with it, we take it live.

How feedback works

You see the real site before your customers do

Point out anything that doesn't feel right

No design or technical vocabulary needed

We make the changes and walk you through them

Launch day, handled

Hosting set up and ready

Your website connected and taken live

Forms and call buttons tested

Checked on phones, tablets and computers

04

Stage 04 · Every month after launch

We keep managing it

This is what makes Website as a Service different. Launch isn't the finish line, and you don't get handed a login and a goodbye. Axiom stays responsible for your website, month after month.

Hosting

Your website lives on secure, managed hosting. We set it up and keep watch over it.

Updates

The software behind your site needs regular updates. We install them and make sure nothing breaks.

Security

We keep your site protected, so it stays safe and trustworthy for your customers.

Backups

Regular backups, so your site can be restored if something ever goes wrong.

Changes

New service, new photos, new hours? Tell us what changed and we'll update your website.

Support

Something not looking right? You reach the people who built your site and know it.

$297

/month

Everything in this stage is part of your plan, from $297 a month. Growth ($597/month) also includes Google Ads management, a CRM and automated follow-up.

After launch

You run your business. We handle the website.

Once your site is live, here's how the work splits. Almost all of it lands on our side. That's the whole point.

Off your plate

Things you won't have to deal with

Finding, setting up and managing website hosting

Installing software updates and hoping nothing breaks

Wondering whether your website is backed up

Figuring out why a page or form stopped working

Learning website software just to change a phone number

Chasing a freelancer who stopped answering

Your part

What we'll ask of you

Tell us when something in your business changes

Send new photos or details when you have them

Let us know if something doesn't look right

Answer the calls and quote requests

That's it. No website logins to remember, no software to learn.

Requesting a change

Need something updated? Just ask.

1

Tell us what you need, in plain words

2

We make the update for you

3

You see it live on your website

Why monthly?

You're not paying off a website. You're paying to have it managed.

A one-time website is finished the day it launches. After that, software goes out of date, your business changes and problems land on you. Your monthly plan keeps a team responsible for your website the whole time you're with us.

A one-time website project

Paid for once, then you're on your own

Build

After launch, it's up to you

Axiom Website as a Service

From $297/month, managed the whole time

Websites need ongoing care

Updates, security and backups don't stop after launch. Someone has to handle them. With Axiom, that's us.

02

Your business keeps changing

New services, photos, prices or hours. Your website keeps up, without you having to learn how to edit it.

03

One price for all of it

Instead of separate bills for a designer, a host and whoever fixes things when they break, it's one plan, from $297 a month.

Get started

Ready to hand off your website?

Tell us a little about your business. We'll talk through what your website needs, answer every question and show you what's possible before you commit to anything.

3

Start the conversation

A few lines is plenty: your business name, what you do and where. We'll review it and reach out personally with the next step.

Get Started See our work first

Or write to us directly at axiom.systems.co@gmail.com
